intro.fr: Outward: Definitive Edition se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Outward: Definitive Edition can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Daemonarian/AP_Outward, qui héberge l'APWorld de Outward: Definitive Edition.
text.en: The GitHub repository Daemonarian/AP_Outward, home of the Outward: Definitive Edition APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.1.0.
text.en: The first version, v0.1.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.2.2, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (4 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.2.2 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (4 versions released).

text.fr: Outward: Definitive Edition figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Outward: Definitive Edition is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
